title: About PocketRPG
why: PocketRPG exists because I wanted something to play with my kids on-the-run. There's a time and a place for scheduled tabletop games, and there's twenty minutes when you're waiting at a bus stop. I reached for the simplest RPGs I could think of, and built an app to give me a pocket full of random ideas as quickly as possible.
thanks: Massive props to Ben Wray (Roll for Shoes) and John Harper (Lasers & Feelings) for building such brilliant microRPGs and making them CreativeCommons.
